plan.title: Remediate dynamic eval in app.py
plan.root_cause: Dynamic eval can execute attacker-controlled code. Use explicit parsing and allowed operations.
plan.strategy: Replace dynamic eval with explicit parsing and allowed operations. Use ast.parse(mode='eval') with recursive evaluation of explicitly allowed numeric nodes and operators. Reject all calls, attributes, names and nonnumeric constants.
risks: Loss of arithmetic behavior during testing
plan.expected_result: All arithmetic tests should pass without executing attacker-controlled code. The build command should complete successfully.

attempts.summary: Replace dynamic eval with explicit parsing and allowed operations in app.py to mitigate the risk of executing attacker-controlled code.

evidence.diff:
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -1,6 +1,27 @@
 """Explicitly labelled KYRO test fixture. Intentionally vulnerable; never deploy."""
+
+import ast
+import operator
+
+allowed_operators = {
+    ast.Add: operator.add,
+    ast.Sub: operator.sub,
+    ast.Mult: operator.mul,
+    ast.Div: operator.truediv,
+    ast.USub: operator.neg,
+}
+
+def evaluate(node):
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Num):  # <number>
+        return node.n
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):  # <left> <operator> <right>
+        return allowed_operators[type(node.op)](evaluate(node.left), evaluate(node.right))
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):  # <operator> <operand> e.g., -1
+        return allowed_operators[type(node.op)](evaluate(node.operand))
+    else:
+        raise TypeError(node)
 
 
 def calculate(expression: str):
     """Preserve arithmetic behavior while testing remediation of dynamic eval."""
-    return eval(expression)
+    return evaluate(ast.parse(expression, mode='eval').body)
